transitions.summary: A full day is spent searching the marketplace for something that leaves no trace there, so sustained effort produces no gain.
A politically significant marriage and a well-placed fief establish conditions under which a clan’s prosperity extends through many generations.
When a great body of water disappears, animals and plants lose their sustaining medium until only collapsed stalks, sand, and stone remain.
Rigidly maintaining position brings discomfort while difficulties cross the threshold, leaving the mind unable to settle into ease.
Movement is physically constrained, yet taboos remain intact and layered defenses create a secure enclosure beyond the reach of disaster.
The farmer repeatedly travels into exposed country for stored grain and returns at dusk untouched by predators, completing necessary work safely.
Even brilliant stars cannot penetrate a darkness generated within authority, where jealousy at the center throws public affairs into disorder.
Rising water breaks its barrier and cuts family continuity short, yet chance prevents injury and permits a return to the safety of home.
Opponents dig in like hostile birds, and neither yields because the conflict lacks the civility or mediation required to resolve a territorial dispute.
A center crowded with harmful influences openly targets good people and sends them toward an impossible road, institutionalizing persecution.
Blossom becomes increasing fruit through steady growth and ripening, eventually offering shared sweetness, nourishment, and sustained material benefit.
A celebrated figure’s vitality declines into premature age, instability, and blindness until the former flame of favorable conditions goes out.
An overgrown tail cannot be directed by the smaller body above it, portraying subordinate power that has become stronger than its nominal ruler.
An army gathered to protect the capital instead wanders without root or direction, increasing the danger and distress of those it was meant to secure.
The traveler mistakes east for west and loses every cardinal bearing, straying far enough that both route and official identity fall away.
A sacred birth founds a dynasty whose reputation spreads outward and whose achievement endures across the whole realm.
Northern wind, snow, and gathering ice externalize an inner condition of grief, leaving the mind troubled and unable to find warmth.
Insects devour the leaves required for silk, so the cloth cannot be completed and scarcity raises its value beyond ordinary reach.
A den ruled by predators cannot support ordinary human life; remaining within it makes the danger structural rather than accidental.
Danger presses close, but sustained watchfulness keeps the threatened bite from landing and allows resources to increase despite the pressure.
Rumor and mutual deception obscure orientation until even the tracks beside the road disappear, leaving no reliable evidence of the way forward.
Sun and moon follow dependable paths to their destinations, making regularity itself the image of peace, safety, and freedom from disruption.
A lively stream becomes an unceasing southward flood that tears through villages and deprives the people of their homes.
A luminous spring rite cannot hold when active light becomes disoriented and defenseless, bringing decline and blame into the ceremonial order.
Practical preparation, mediation, and due ceremony unite two clans in affection, satisfying both the couple and the parents who receive them.
An eclipse portrays the upper power obscuring and damaging what depends upon it, while the historical image shows a successor driven from his place.
A lingering blaze moves through the heavenly routes and consumes essential materials, leaving divided communities to mourn a disaster whose source is unclear.
Drums and threatening orders announce battle, but troops scatter instead of acting; authority unable to secure response proceeds directly to defeat.
An impressive dragon is drawn without a body, just as polished speech lacks substance when no authentic core supports its surface.
Even when heaven and earth appear to overturn, a surrounding spiritual protection preserves safety, happiness, and freedom from blame.
A birth at an ancestral mountain receives supreme approval, establishing an image of abundant favor, distinction, and continuity.
When peace cannot be found within the home, instability at the intimate center leaves the wider situation exposed to sudden disaster.
Wild animals flee human presence in every direction but find no clear shelter, turning escape into disorganized exposure.
The celestial threshold stands vacant while danger approaches, and one who cannot hear or speak effectively submits to a fatal sentence.
Travel through darkness and dangerous heights ends in a ditch, ruining clothing and breaking the vehicle’s ability to continue.
A soft blade cannot shape jade, while a master craftsperson and principled helpers can animate difficult material and bring sincere aims toward completion.
Repeated streams and hills reduce strong cattle to a crawl and prevent vehicles from carrying full loads, leaving desired results beyond reach.
A person leaves home and a disordered society behind, carrying necessities while refusing public position in order to preserve private integrity.
A ruler’s transgressive relationship drives relentless travel and regret, binding movement to conduct that cannot settle into an honorable return.
Two great lights occupy the same path and blot one another out, while collapsing peaks transform stable heights into flooded valleys.
Heaven’s gate and the prison doors open together as restraints fall away, allowing the confined person to return home.
Circling phoenixes mark a realm free of calamity, where multiplied benefit accompanies a successful return to the place of origin.
Spring blossoms accompany a young woman entering a new household, where lasting blessing and her partner’s rising status extend the union’s promise.
The traveler carries exactly enough food to reach distant opportunity, showing that measured preparation can support a favorable result without excess.
Dense foliage gathers gentle birds around a mother feeding her young, making remembered care the center of communal gratitude.
A small vehicle pushed up a mountain cannot meet the scale of the task, so repeated stumbling turns effort into distress.
Countless beings and buried insects rise into activity, joining seasonal release with vitality, prosperity, and widened freedom of action.
Banners announce organized presence across the fields, yet a precious object remains stranded because no practical means exists to carry it out.
